---
title: "Regression Tree"
author: "Jia Ren"
date: "2025-05-09"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tree)
set.seed(1)
n       <- nrow(df)
train_i <- sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.9 * n)

df_train <- df[ train_i, ]
df_test  <- df[-train_i, ]

tree_full <- tree(
  duration ~ region
           + Strength_picked_r + Strength_picked_d
           + Agility_picked_r  + Agility_picked_d
           + Intelligence_picked_r + Intelligence_picked_d
           + Universal_picked_r    + Universal_picked_d
           + first_blood_time
           + dire_score + radiant_score  
           + poly(exp_15min, 2)           
           + teamfight_duration + teamfight_frequency
           + Tteamfight_deaths,
  data = df_train
)

cv_tree <- cv.tree(tree_full, FUN = prune.tree, K = 10)

plot(cv_tree$size, cv_tree$dev, type = "b",
     xlab = "Number of Terminal Nodes",
     ylab = "Cross‐Validated Sum‐of‐Squares Error",
     main = "10‑Fold CV: Error vs. Tree Size")

opt_size <- cv_tree$size[which.min(cv_tree$dev)]
cat("Optimal tree size (terminal nodes) =", opt_size, "\n")

tree_pruned <- prune.tree(tree_full, best = opt_size)

n  <- nrow(df)
K  <- 10
sse_per_fold_avg <- min(cv_tree$dev)
cv_rmse <- sqrt(sse_per_fold_avg * K / n)
cat("10‑fold CV RMSE ≈", round(cv_rmse, 2), "\n")
plot(tree_pruned)
text(tree_pruned, pretty = 0, cex = 0.8)


pred_test   <- predict(tree_pruned, newdata = df_test)
actual_test <- df_test$duration

SSE <- sum((actual_test - pred_test)^2)
SST <- sum((actual_test - mean(actual_test))^2)

R2  <- 1 - SSE/SST
cat("Test‑set R² =", round(R2, 3), "\n")

test_mse <- mean((pred_test - actual_test)^2)
cat("Test MSE =", round(test_mse, 3), "\n")
```
